claim: A plain invisible sprite with an XSPRITE is a delay: given rest state 0, a wait_time and trigger_off only, an On it receives posts its own return to Off after wait_time tenths, and that Off edge sends its command (On) to its tx channel. Two such sprites on one sender give two delays without any timer type.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:98-99 (SetSpriteState posts the return after waitTime * 120 / 10 ticks when restState differs)
NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:102-105 (triggerOn sends on the On edge, triggerOff on the Off edge)
E4L1 passes 06/07: briefing-arm-delay (2.7 s) and briefing-collapse-delay (3.0 s), circuit read-back agrees
use: Declare the relay on a wiring.Circuit like any sender; read the chain back with bloodmap.posed to see where it ends.
